name: wsi-fetcher
description: Fetch WSI files for SlideIDs provided in the Airflow DagRun conf object.

templates.description: Fetch WSI files from a configured source and write a manifest.

env.name: WSI_SOURCE
env.description: WSI source backend. Filesystem is intended for local/offline tests.

env.name: WSI_INPUT_DIR
env.description: Filesystem directory containing source WSI files for local/offline tests.

env.name: OBJECT_STORAGE_ENDPOINT
env.description: External S3-compatible object-store endpoint, for example object-store.example.org:9000.

env.name: OBJECT_STORAGE_BUCKET
env.description: External object-store bucket containing WSI files or SlideID folders.

env.name: OBJECT_STORAGE_ACCESS_KEY
env.description: Access key for the external object store.

env.name: OBJECT_STORAGE_SECRET_KEY
env.description: Secret key for the external object store.

env.name: OBJECT_STORAGE_SECURE
env.description: Use HTTPS when connecting to the external object store.

env.name: IMS_BASE_URL
env.description: Base URL for IMS REST retrieval.

env.name: IMS_GET_ENDPOINT
env.description: IMS endpoint that accepts a slide_id query parameter.

env.name: IMS_AUTH_TOKEN
env.description: Optional bearer token for IMS REST retrieval.
